authorization.implementation: authorized after this protocol and sidecar are committed
authorization.smoke: requires focused tests pass and hashed implementation_review.json status go
authorization.development: requires completed structural smoke_decision.json and hashed pre_screen_review.json status go
authorization.prior_regression: requires hashed development promotion_decision.json with exactly one locked candidate
authorization.confirmation: requires the same promotion decision hash plus hashed prior_regression_decision.json status pass; confirmation banks may not be generated earlier

question: Is the remaining OI nuisance failure caused by transferring one overconfident sample-weighted pooled diagonal precision metric across heterogeneous class scale, and can partial whitening, robust scale, or class-balanced pooling repair it?
claim_scope: ordered mechanistic concordance, not formal causal mediation or universal behavior

conditioning.held_out_policy: apply frozen transform; predict and score_fixed never refit
conditioning.residual: x_i minus its training class mean
conditioning.weighted_median: stable sort by (value, original_row_index); smallest value with cumulative normalized weight >= 0.5
conditioning.winsor_weighting_isolation: SW and CB share sample-weighted median/MAD clip thresholds and sample-weighted OAS alpha; only final diagonal moment weights differ
conditioning.mad_weighting: MAD-only SW/CB candidates apply their declared weights in the median
conditioning.regularization: raw variance=max(raw variance,0); if largest<=0 use identity; otherwise effective_floor=max(largest*1e-8,largest/1e4) and regularized=max(raw,effective_floor)
conditioning.balanced_weighting_identity: SW and CB route through one code path and must be bit-identical when class counts are equal
conditioning.invalid_input: reject sparse, non-2D, nonnumeric, nonfinite, feature-mismatch, unknown estimator/weighting, gamma outside [0,1], nonscalar/multilabel targets, fewer than two classes, duplicate explicit refinement kwargs

bank_recipe.nuisance_dim_nesting: d4 is first four coordinates of d32
bank_recipe.nuisance_sharing: same pool-specific banks across signal states, scenarios, balances, count levels, and k
bank_recipe.ring_draw_order: all class-major (4,320) angles then all (4,320) radial perturbations
bank_recipe.overlap_draw_order: class0 shared then private; class1 shared then private; class2 private; class3 private; interleave shared/private
bank_recipe.contamination: row mask shared over features; false uses common Gaussian bank; true uses 8*independent standard-normal outlier bank; divide all by sqrt(4.15)
bank_recipe.nested_selection: select class-major prefixes before row permutation
bank_recipe.row_permutation: apply after concatenated class selection; shared across scenarios, nuisance dims, and k

nuisance.scale_values: four log-spaced values from R^(-1/2) to R^(1/2), normalized to unweighted mean square one
nuisance.gaussian: normal inverse CDF of clipped common uniform bank
nuisance.student_t5: t(5) inverse CDF of common uniform bank multiplied by sqrt(3/5)

selector.reference_labels: first-observed deterministic integer encoding for sklearn fit; original labels retained for OI
selector.reference_best: maximum held-out accuracy in reported subpanel

linear_probe_selector.standardization: sklearn.preprocessing.StandardScaler fit within training fold only
linear_probe_selector.stratification: first-observed deterministic integer encoding of original scalar labels for split and sklearn fit

selector.promotion_regret_formula: complete-seed paired candidate linear-head regret minus linear-probe-selector linear-head regret on six nuisance items
selector.nonlinear_retention_formula: complete-seed paired candidate regret minus B regret on six nuisance items, separately for quadratic, knn, and rbf
selector.balance_aggregation: report balanced and imbalanced separately; promotion averages the two stratum means equally within seed
selector.rank_auc: normalized trapezoid over small/large count on log2(total_rows)
selector.completeness: all expected unique finite items required

diagnostics.oracle_use: diagnostic only; never fit or select candidate
diagnostics.primary_neighbor_endpoint: separated-state held-out cross-class top-k neighbor impurity
diagnostics.primary_neighbor_aggregation: row mean per case; equal cell mean within seed over two separated signals, nuisance dims, count levels, and k
diagnostics.fold_stability: five deterministic stratified folds; integer labels only for split planning; original labels to fit; all ten fold-pair scale comparisons
diagnostics.adjacency_validation: post-score_fixed directional supports/hits/evidence must exactly match OI sparse_adj, _pairwise_hits, and 1-pairwise_index; under-prototyped labels recorded

statistics.auroc_auprc: archived pooled-row complete-seed bootstrap; archived stable directed-pair ordering

primary_claims.q3: within-draw max of balanced W50-SW-vs-P50-SW DiD for T-H2 and C-H2; upper 98.75 bound < 0
primary_claims.q4: [W50-CB imbalance penalty on H2]-[W50-SW imbalance penalty on H2]; upper 98.75 bound < 0

negative_controls.q2: within-draw max P50-SW-minus-L over balanced S0/S1/S2

statistics.family_drift: for each candidate, scenario block, and seed, equally average absolute OI evidence error over the complete 2 balance x 2 nuisance-dim x 2 count x 2 k x 3 signal = 48 cells; bootstrap the paired candidate-minus-B seed means; each block upper 95 bound <= 0.02

stable_shift.lower_is_better: [(shift_candidate-stable_candidate)-(shift_B-stable_B)] for Brier, clean MAE, and absolute nuisance-drift error

statistics.lock_false_overlap: maximum over separated S2/H2/T/C/X/ALL-by-balance candidate-minus-B upper 95 bound for mean directed 0->1/1->0 evidence

genuine_overlap_gates.pair_rows: complete directed off-diagonal class-pair support/hits/evidence; pair label binary and truth overlap continuous
genuine_overlap_gates.separated_fpr: if B pooled FPR >= 0.10, candidate-minus-B upper paired 95 bound must be strictly < 0; otherwise <= 0.02
genuine_overlap_gates.clean_mae: candidate-minus-B upper paired 95 bound <= 0.05 on S0
genuine_overlap_gates.brier: candidate-minus-B upper paired 95 bound <= 0.05 against continuous pair-overlap truth

severity_curves.candidate_minimum_vs_B: candidate point value >= B point value - 0.05

genuine_overlap_gates.strata_fnr: for every k-by-balance stratum on genuine-overlap rows, candidate-minus-B upper paired 95 bound <= 0; crossing zero with upper <= 0.05 is inconclusive and does not pass; low > 0 or upper > 0.05 fails
genuine_overlap_gates.pooling: archived pooled directed-row estimands within complete seed resamples; every expected block/balance/dimension/count/k/signal identity required

resource_gates.scope: R0-R3 only; development B,L,and all promotable candidates; confirmation B and locked candidate
resource_gates.paired_ratio_unit: candidate/B within identical seed and resource cell
resource_gates.aggregation: pool all paired ratios across the complete four resource cells and all stage seeds (48 development ratios; 96 confirmation ratios); report cells separately but apply median/p95 gates to the pooled ratios
resource_gates.individual_memory_statistic: maximum over every paired seed-by-resource-cell ratio

eligibility.determinism: exact fitted state, structural diagnostics, predictions, and scores
eligibility.leakage: train-only conditioning and references; predict/score_fixed no refit
eligibility.genuine_overlap: all gates in genuine_overlap_gates must pass
eligibility.resources: all gates in resource_gates must pass; missing mandatory memory is inconclusive

resources.counterbalance: deterministic hash-seeded cyclic; every method position-count max difference one; observed equals manifest
resources.timing_policy: measure stages directly; never derive by subtraction

smoke.outcome_use: structural/invariant checks only; no rankings, gates, thresholds, or design amendments
smoke.cells: 18 seed-21000 scenario-by-balance small/d4/k2/linear; exact 9 seed-21001 tuples in smoke_cells.group_2; 3 seed-21002 ALL/imbalanced/large/d32/k8 signal states

development.purpose: diagnose effects and lock one candidate

prior_regression.failure: reject lock; do not reopen ranking

confirmation.algorithm_decision: locked candidate must pass all gates
confirmation.mechanism_decision: all four claims reported separately; all required for mechanism confirmation; mechanism failure alone does not reject algorithm

food101.next_step: separate pre-outcome protocol after synthetic confirmation

smoke_cells.group_1: seed 21000; all 9 scenarios x 2 balances; small; d4; k2; linear
smoke_cells.group_3: seed 21002; ALL; imbalanced; large; d32; k8; all 3 signals

stop_semantics.atomic_block: finish current block, emit stopped artifact, never analyze incomplete block

artifact_contract.table_order: canonical case and method order; byte-stable across PYTHONHASHSEED
artifact_contract.manifest_table_identity: schema, row count, and SHA-256 per normalized table
artifact_contract.checkpoint: one atomic identity-validated JSON object per complete case; no monolithic rewrite

decision_artifacts.implementation_review.json: hash and go status consumed by smoke
decision_artifacts.smoke_decision.json: structural pass and hash consumed by development
decision_artifacts.pre_screen_review.json: hash and go status consumed by development
decision_artifacts.promotion_decision.json: exactly one locked candidate plus input/protocol/code hashes consumed by prior regression and confirmation
decision_artifacts.prior_regression_decision.json: same lock hash and pass status consumed by confirmation
decision_artifacts.confirmation_decision.json: separate algorithm and four mechanism statuses

artifact_contract.decision_consumption: every consumer serializes the exact SHA-256 of each prerequisite decision and fails on mismatch
